title: Geometric Structures on Graphs: a Holonomy-Based Discretization of Curvature
summary: We propose a holonomy-based framework for discretizing curvature on graphs equipped with local symmetric positive-definite metrics. Each vertex carries a fibre metric \(g_i\), and each directed edge carries a reversible metric-compatible transport \(F_{ij}\). The ordered product around an oriented triangular loop \(\mathcal C\) gives a holonomy \(H_{\mathcal C}\), whose normalized logarithm \(Ω_{\mathcal C}=-s_{\mathcal C}^{-1}\operatorname{Log}(H_{\mathcal C})\) is used as a finite-loop curvature observation.
